ideas.falsifier: If naive int4/int2, rotated, variance-normalized, and covariance-aware methods have identical accuracy-vs-length curves, the idea loses priority.
ideas.minimum_test: Tensor-only or tiny-transformer pseudo-decode with stored K/V tensors, quantized variants, and decode-length sweeps.
ideas.name: KV Error Accumulation Wind Tunnel
ideas.question: Do cache quantization errors that look tolerable in static/prefill probes accumulate catastrophically during autoregressive decode? Which statistic predicts collapse: MSE, inner-product error, token-scale error, or top-tail outliers?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Mostly tensor algebra and generated sequences; no large training needed.

ideas.falsifier: If cache features are no better than final hidden states, length, entropy, or random projections, keep as note only.
ideas.minimum_test: Train a tiny model on generated tasks; freeze it; fit classifiers/regressors on summary features of its KV cache to predict correctness/uncertainty/need-more-compute.
ideas.name: Cache as a Free Representation
ideas.question: Can the KV cache itself serve as a cheap state embedding for deciding whether to sample more, stop, route to a slow path, or predict correctness?
ideas.why_scale_fits: The downstream probes can be logistic regression or tiny MLPs over small cached tensors.

ideas.falsifier: If learned policies collapse to recency/attention mass and do not transfer to longer traces, demote.
ideas.minimum_test: Synthetic reasoning traces with an oracle full-cache solver; learn or evolve a retention policy under a memory budget.
ideas.name: Learned Forgetting / Neural Garbage Collection
ideas.question: Can a small controller learn which tokens/slots/heads to forget from final outcome, and does it discover non-obvious recurrence or semantic-unit behavior?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Policy can be tiny; tasks are generated; reward can be exact.

ideas.falsifier: If spectral memory only wins when rank is effectively full cache, mark as too expensive.
ideas.minimum_test: Implement small SKA-like memory using kernel/ridge spectral summaries; compare with attention oracle, additive linear attention, delta-rule memory, and fixed hidden state.
ideas.name: Koopman / Spectral Associative Recall
ideas.question: Can constant-memory spectral sufficient statistics preserve content-addressed key-value recall where additive recurrence fails?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Associative recall is synthetic and controllable; matrices can be tiny.

ideas.falsifier: If it helps only language loss but not exact recall, keep as lower-priority architecture spice.
ideas.minimum_test: Tiny model with dynamic 3-7 token filters over Q/K/V on associative recall and induction tasks.
ideas.name: Dynamic Local Preconditioning for Attention
ideas.question: Does an input-dependent short convolution before Q/K/V help tiny Transformers learn retrieval circuits faster than static local convolutions or plain attention?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small architectural patch; synthetic tasks have fast feedback.

ideas.falsifier: If many seeds pass validation but no stable sufficient subprogram appears, record that too: useful negative result.
ideas.minimum_test: Train on simple formal/algorithmic tasks; inspect attention patterns, causal ablations, and threshold-like MLP features; manually recover enough of the program.
ideas.name: RASP Decompiler Lite
ideas.question: When a tiny Transformer length-generalizes, did it learn a crisp program we can actually extract, or only a fragile interpolation trick?
ideas.why_scale_fits: No big model; small exact tasks and mechanistic inspection.

ideas.falsifier: If entropy and margin are equally predictive in the tiny setting, the large-model claim may not miniaturize.
ideas.minimum_test: Install synthetic facts via training/adapters; query present, conflicting, and absent facts; compute nearest-basin/margin measures.
ideas.name: Hidden-State Attractor Margin Probe
ideas.question: Can hidden-state geometry distinguish correct recall, conflicting recall, and absent facts better than output entropy in a tiny controlled memory model?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small vocabulary and exact ground truth; can use PCA/prototype distances.

ideas.falsifier: If static interleaving matches adaptive routing across tasks, keep the simpler static hybrid.
ideas.minimum_test: Generated streams with local filler and sparse retrieval-critical segments; train/evolve a router to choose attention vs recurrence at each chunk.
ideas.name: Sequence-Axis Hybrid Router
ideas.question: Can a model or policy learn when to spend full attention and when cheap recurrence is enough within the same sequence?
ideas.why_scale_fits: The router/hybrid can be simulated with small modules; exact budget metrics.

ideas.falsifier: If memory tricks only match well-tuned reservoir/top-k baselines, postpone.
ideas.minimum_test: Same associative recall task, same memory bytes: full attention oracle, sliding window, Trellis-like fixed slots, KVM-like block means, gradient-written tokens, surprise memory, ATLAS-like batch update.
ideas.name: Writable Memory Shootout
ideas.question: What is the smallest setting where writable memory beats plain attention under a fixed memory budget, and which write rule actually matters?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Can start with toy tensor memories before training full sequence models.

ideas.falsifier: If gains disappear under adversarial distractors or different seeds, keep as setup-dependent.
ideas.minimum_test: Train at length 128/256, evaluate to 4096 on fixed-pattern retrieval and bracket/formal tasks; plot wrong-position and attention-dispersion failures.
ideas.name: Position + Sparse Attention Length Extrapolation
ideas.question: Do CoPE-style RoPE clipping and sparse/entmax attention help tiny models extrapolate to longer lengths, or do they just shift failure modes?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Cheap graphs and exact length sweeps.

ideas.falsifier: If all methods reduce to preserving the exact dependency graph, then the research value becomes graph recovery, not cache compression.
ideas.minimum_test: Generate symbolic proof/scratch traces with known dependency graph; remove tokens/segments/heads and measure final-task damage.
ideas.name: Reasoning Trace Compression Bench
ideas.question: Are reasoning traces compressible by token importance, segment importance, answer contribution, or head importance?
ideas.why_scale_fits: No need for natural-language reasoning; synthetic dependency graphs are enough.

ideas.falsifier: If all variants obey the same capacity curve once normalized for rank/state size, deprioritize architectural variants.
ideas.minimum_test: Pure tensor fast-weight simulations, then tiny trained modules; sweep key dimension, pair count, noise, corrections, and repeated writes.
ideas.name: Linear Memory Capacity Boundary
ideas.question: Where exactly do delta-rule, Kaczmarz, variational, and gated linear memories break as keys collide and pairs exceed head dimension?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Very cheap; likely to produce crisp phase diagrams.

ideas.falsifier: If explicit scratchpad always wins at same compute and memory, focus on scratchpad compression instead.
ideas.minimum_test: Pointer chasing, iterative arithmetic, and associative recall with looped hidden state vs explicit generated scratch sequence.
ideas.name: Compressed Loop vs Explicit Scratchpad
ideas.question: When does hidden recurrent looping replace explicit scratchpad tokens, and when does it fail because the persistent state is too small?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small tasks; loop count is controllable.

ideas.falsifier: If a simple hand-coded recurrent baseline dominates all learned models, the benchmark is too easy or architecture-insensitive.
ideas.minimum_test: Start with stack automata/grid worlds/mini move systems; predict exact state after sequence; include random-action OOD split.
ideas.name: Toy State-Tracking World Model
ideas.question: Can small models maintain exact latent state over action sequences, and do recurrent/hybrid mixers beat causal attention at tiny scale?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Synthetic generator, exact labels, small models.

ideas.falsifier: If task accuracy is insensitive to all transforms at small scale, move to larger local pretrained models only if available.
ideas.minimum_test: Collect K/V tensors from small trained models and compare identity, Hadamard, random orthogonal, PCA, covariance-aware, and grouped-coordinate quantizers.
ideas.name: Transform Coding / Geometry of KV Tensors
ideas.question: Is KV compression mostly about coordinate decorrelation, rotational smoothing, dimension allocation, or entropy coding?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Tensor-only after a small cache corpus is collected.

ideas.falsifier: If memory bank just memorizes IDs and fails paraphrase/generalization in controlled variants, deprioritize.
ideas.minimum_test: Tiny fact-family tasks with continued training and edits; compare dense model, memory bank, token-indexed table, Hopfield edit wrapper.
ideas.name: Persistent Memory Bank / Chapter Router
ideas.question: Can explicit parametric memory tables or routed memory chapters store editable facts with less interference than dense weights?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Can use tiny fact sets and exact interference metrics.

ideas.falsifier: If runs are too seed-sensitive for our CPU budget, preserve as background.
ideas.minimum_test: Modular arithmetic and structured matrix-output tasks with spherical constraints, uniform attention, Fourier probes, and data-size sweeps.
ideas.name: Grokking Geometry Side Lab
ideas.question: Can architecture/topology change whether tiny models memorize first and generalize later, and can we see algorithmic structure before generalization?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small data but many optimization steps; good overnight/long-run lane.

ideas.falsifier: If tuning bandwidth dominates results, this is too fiddly for early project shape.
ideas.minimum_test: Local constant vs local linear kernel attention on noisy key-value pairs; no language pretraining needed.
ideas.name: Local Linear / Parallax Attention Probe
ideas.question: Can covariance-probing local-linear attention improve associative memory under noisy retrieval at tiny scale?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small linear algebra plus synthetic data.

ideas.falsifier: If global top-k never wipes out vital regions on adversarially generated traces, demote the AMS-inspired lane.
ideas.minimum_test: Synthetic reasoning traces with multiple contiguous proof blocks; compare top-k token retention against region quota retention.
ideas.name: Region-Wipeout Cache Fragmentation
ideas.question: Do token-level global top-k retention methods fail because they erase entire contiguous reasoning regions, even when they keep high-scoring isolated tokens?
ideas.why_scale_fits: No training required; generated traces and oracle labels are enough for first maps.

ideas.falsifier: If all methods solve long pointer chasing with tiny cache and shallow depth, the theoretical lane is not biting at our scale.
ideas.minimum_test: Pointer-chase datasets with controlled hops; compare full cache, sliding cache, top-k cache, looped hidden state, and explicit scratchpad tokens.
ideas.name: Depth-Cache Pointer-Chase Battery
ideas.question: How much cache budget is actually required for multi-hop pointer chasing, and when does extra loop/depth stop helping?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Pointer chasing is tiny, exact, and adversarially tunable.

ideas.falsifier: If simple attention/recency baselines retain dormant anchors as well as sponsorship at tight budgets, sponsorship is less interesting.
ideas.minimum_test: Anchor-value synthetic streams: key:, password:, coordinate:, rule-id: tokens are ignored until late query; compare statistical and sponsor policies.
ideas.name: Dormant Token Sponsorship
ideas.question: Can a cache policy preserve tokens that have no attention mass because their future value is semantic/structural rather than statistical?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Can be tested with deterministic token streams and lightweight scorers before using a neural model.

ideas.falsifier: If memory tokens behave as a smooth parameter-count bump rather than a thresholded scratchpad, this lane changes shape.
ideas.minimum_test: Train tiny Universal Transformer variants on bracket constraints, parity-with-carry, or mini-Sudoku; sweep memory-token count and halt bias.
ideas.name: Memory-Token Thresholds in Recursive Models
ideas.question: Do weight-shared recursive transformers need dedicated memory/register tokens, and is there a sharp threshold/dilution curve even on much simpler tasks than Sudoku?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small algorithmic tasks fit CPU; the result is interpretable even when accuracy is modest.

ideas.falsifier: If compressed loops solve tasks requiring growing working memory without growing state, revisit assumptions and inspect leakage.
ideas.minimum_test: Compare compressed looped models, full sequence-state loops, and explicit scratchpad solvers on pointer-chasing and associative recall.
ideas.name: Looped Latent State vs Explicit Scratchpad
ideas.question: When does latent recurrent computation fail because it has finite state while explicit generated scratchpad tokens keep growing?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Can start with symbolic simulators and small tensors; no large LM required.

ideas.falsifier: If extracted/synthesized programs do not track length generalization better than accuracy, keep RASP as analysis-only.
ideas.minimum_test: Train tiny models on exact formal-language tasks; run hand-built RASP-like probes and compare against synthesized minimal programs.
ideas.name: Executable RASP Success Criterion
ideas.question: Can we score tiny transformer experiments by whether a short program can be extracted or synthesized, not just whether held-out accuracy is high?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Formal tasks are tiny; the real work is instrumentation, not compute.

ideas.falsifier: If diagnostics lag validation or are seed-noisy, they are not good steering signals.
ideas.minimum_test: Modular arithmetic runs with live head-cosine, entropy-std, Fourier phase, and norm logs.
ideas.name: Cheap Grokking Diagnostics as Early Warning
ideas.question: Can attention/activation order parameters reveal circuit formation before validation accuracy jumps?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Modular arithmetic is the classic tiny experiment; diagnostics are cheap.

ideas.falsifier: If gating helps only by adding near-full-rank capacity, demote.
ideas.minimum_test: Extend the spectral associative probe with a context variable that gates keys before retrieval.
ideas.name: Context-Gated Associative Memory
ideas.question: Can an external context gate reshape a tiny associative memory enough to beat nearest-neighbor/linear memory under collisions?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Generated continuous keys/values are cheap and the failure modes are geometric.

ideas.falsifier: If phase compression behaves like random projection under all probes, demote.
ideas.minimum_test: Approximate phase-coded compression on generated K/V tensors and retrieval tasks with position-sensitive queries.
ideas.name: Trigonometric/Phase KV Compression
ideas.question: Do phase/trigonometric encodings preserve long-range positional or semantic structure better than scalar quantization at tiny cache budgets?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Mostly tensor algebra; can be prototyped before implementing custom attention.

ideas.falsifier: If it becomes a compute sink before producing interpretable phase plots, postpone.
ideas.minimum_test: Tiny discrete/continuous flow-matching on modular addition, compared to transformer and MLP grokking baselines.
ideas.name: Iterative Denoising as Tiny Reasoning
ideas.question: Can diffusion-style iterative refinement learn modular/algorithmic tasks in a way that reveals different reasoning phases from transformers?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small symbolic diffusion can run on CPU if kept tiny.

ideas.falsifier: If region-aware quotas do not outperform global top-k on deliberately region-structured traces, the simulator is not stressing the claimed failure mode.
ideas.minimum_test: Run region_wipeout_probe.py across budgets and compare global_topk, recency, even quotas, mass_segmented, and oracle.
ideas.name: Region-Wipeout Cache Compression Simulator
ideas.question: When does token-level global top-k delete entire reasoning regions even when it keeps many high-score tokens?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Pure symbolic/numpy simulation; no model training required.

ideas.falsifier: If direct attention/recency policies retain target values at tiny budgets, the dormant-token assumptions are too weak.
ideas.minimum_test: Run dormant_sponsorship_probe.py and sweep budgets, false-positive anchors, and sponsorship windows.
ideas.name: Dormant-Token Sponsorship Trap
ideas.question: Can any score-only retention policy keep value tokens that are deliberately attention-dormant until the final query?
ideas.why_scale_fits: A tiny symbolic setup captures the core trap before any LLM instrumentation.

ideas.falsifier: If value-norm protection does not recover critical low-attention tokens in the controlled trap, demote.
ideas.minimum_test: Run value_outlier_probe.py; later replace synthetic value norms with actual tiny-transformer V activations.
ideas.name: Value-Outlier Stochastic Eviction
ideas.question: Is protecting large value-norm tokens plus diversity sampling a better default than attention top-k under reasoning-like cache traps?
ideas.why_scale_fits: The first pass is pure numpy; the second pass only needs a tiny trained transformer.

ideas.falsifier: If L2 memory only helps when its rank effectively stores the full cache, keep as diagnostic not architecture.
ideas.minimum_test: Add an L1 sliding window + L2 outer-product memory to spectral associative recall and region-wipeout tasks.
ideas.name: Eviction-Conditioned L2 Tensor Cache
ideas.question: Can evicted local-cache tokens be summarized into an outer-product memory that rescues retrieval without growing linearly?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Matrix memories are small and CPU-friendly; no custom kernels needed.

ideas.falsifier: If support recovery is as brittle as softmax tail truncation in all toy tasks, demote.
ideas.minimum_test: Implement sparsemax/entmax toy attention and compare output error when the support is fully or partially retained.
ideas.name: Entmax Support-Recovery Cache
ideas.question: Does exact-zero sparse attention make cache pruning a support-recovery problem with clearer success criteria?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Single-head tensor algebra; useful graphs without training.

ideas.falsifier: If fixed-point loops only memorize training shapes or fail to converge stably, postpone.
ideas.minimum_test: Use small recurrent/refinement MLP or transformer block on maze/state tasks; log convergence and failure cycles.
ideas.name: Attractor Refinement Tiny Reasoner
ideas.question: Can fixed-point refinement solve tiny maze/constraint tasks with fewer parameters than equivalent feed-forward depth?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Tiny tasks and small hidden states fit CPU; convergence curves are informative.

ideas.falsifier: If gains vanish against matched-depth baselines, file under architecture tax.
ideas.minimum_test: Generate synthetic forecasting/tabular datasets with hidden factors; compare no-loop, deeper, weight-tied loop, and feedback-token variants.
ideas.name: Feedback-Token Latent CoT for Structured Data
ideas.question: Do feedback tokens help toy tabular/time-series tasks by creating a reusable latent scratchpad?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small data and tiny networks; can be run in batches on CPU.

ideas.falsifier: If extraction cannot recover toy circuits that we know are simple, simplify model family first.
ideas.minimum_test: Train tiny discrete/low-rank transformers on sorting/parity/Dyck-lite and score recovered code/program equivalence.
ideas.name: Weights-to-Code Tiny Program Arena
ideas.question: Can we bias tiny models toward circuits that are decompilable rather than merely accurate?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Algorithmic tasks are tiny; program extraction is a sharper artifact than perplexity.

ideas.falsifier: If hidden states do not separate even on tiny DFAs, change architecture/instrumentation.
ideas.minimum_test: Train small models on DFA/state tracking with noisy/skipped steps; cluster hidden states and attempt DFA extraction.
ideas.name: Finite-State CoT Extraction Battery
ideas.question: Does explicit scratchpad create more linearly separable finite-state variables than compressed latent loops?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Regular languages and DFAs are cheap and exact.

ideas.falsifier: If training loop overhead overwhelms insight, keep as later side quest.
ideas.minimum_test: Compare masked diffusion and autoregressive objectives on tiny grammar/program datasets with matched steps.
ideas.name: Data-Constrained Diffusion-vs-AR Toy LM
ideas.question: Are diffusion-style language models more sample-efficient than AR on tiny symbolic corpora, or is that claim scale/data-distribution dependent?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Toy vocabularies and short sequences are CPU-feasible.

ideas.falsifier: If quantization only slows training without qualitative circuit differences, demote.
ideas.minimum_test: Train BitLinear-style tiny blocks on modular arithmetic, DFA, and associative recall; compare extracted circuits and grokking.
ideas.name: Native Ternary Circuit Survival
ideas.question: Which tiny transformer circuits survive native {-1,0,1} weight constraints?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small parameter counts make native low-bit experimentation easy.

ideas.falsifier: If adaptive budgets collapse to always-max or always-min, redesign cost penalty.
ideas.minimum_test: Add future-query sampling to dormant and region-wipeout simulators; compare fixed K vs adaptive K and adaptive policy choice.
ideas.name: Adaptive Budget Voting for Cache Traps
ideas.question: Can a query-sampling/voting policy identify when a request needs more cache or different retention before the final query arrives?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Simulator-generated queries make the policy cheap to train/test.

ideas.falsifier: If all variants match across direction-sensitive tasks and K=V has no consistent tradeoff, deprioritize projection sharing.
ideas.minimum_test: Train tiny attention models under QKV, K=V, Q=K, and Q=K=V on key-value retrieval and direction-sensitive tasks.
ideas.name: QKV Projection Sharing Mini-Arena
ideas.question: Which Q/K/V projection roles are actually necessary for tiny content-addressed retrieval, directionality, and cache savings?
ideas.why_scale_fits: CPU-sized synthetic data; few thousand examples; model under 100k params.

ideas.falsifier: If moment correction never helps under constructed directional-gap cases, keep as a negative result.
ideas.minimum_test: Synthetic attention output with hidden evicted directions; compare kept-only, mean correction, first-order moment correction, and random/mass baselines.
ideas.name: MomentKV Directional Gap Probe
ideas.question: Can low attention mass still carry a value direction that top-k retention cannot reconstruct, and can moment summaries repair it?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Pure NumPy tensor algebra; no training required.

ideas.falsifier: If all constructed streams are solved by simple recency or top-mass, postpone.
ideas.minimum_test: Generate query/key/value streams with adversarial late queries, clustered keys, and balanced mass; score cache algorithms against oracle full attention.
ideas.name: Streaming-Attention Adversary Generator
ideas.question: Can we design tiny streams that break every fixed-space heuristic in qualitatively different ways?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Pure synthetic streams; ties cache heuristics to theory lane.

ideas.falsifier: If SMT labels are no better than hand-coded recurrence on tasks, keep as side lane.
ideas.minimum_test: Train teacher encoder on synthetic future prediction; distill m_t,x_t -> m_{t+1}; compare RNN trained by SMT vs BPTT.
ideas.name: Supervised Memory Training Tiny Teacher
ideas.question: Can a transformer teacher produce predictive-state memory labels that let a tiny RNN learn long memory without BPTT?
ideas.why_scale_fits: All sequences are generated and tiny; teacher can be a shallow transformer.

ideas.falsifier: If rank axis is trivial in embeddings before training or absent after training, refine task.
ideas.minimum_test: Adjacent-comparison dataset; PCA/linear probes on embeddings; symbolic-distance confidence curves.
ideas.name: Ordinal Geometry / Mental Number Line Toy
ideas.question: Do small models trained only on local comparisons form a recoverable rank axis, and can we detect it before OOD accuracy jumps?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Tiny vocabulary and tiny transformer/MLP suffice.

ideas.falsifier: If telemetry adds no predictive signal beyond validation accuracy, deprioritize.
ideas.minimum_test: Log norms, spectral features, train/test accuracy, and attention mass on informative tokens across seeds.
ideas.name: Grokking Phase-Transition Telemetry
ideas.question: Do norm peaks and mechanism-landscape transitions appear in our tiny modular arithmetic runs?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small modular tasks are slow in steps but cheap in memory.

ideas.falsifier: If rank-0/shared KV is as good as full KV on multi-relation tasks, the task is too easy.
ideas.minimum_test: Multi-relation associative recall with heads specialized to relation families; sweep residual rank.
ideas.name: Low-Rank Head Diversity Map
ideas.question: How much low-rank head-specific residual is needed before shared-KV attention recovers diverse head functions?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small trained attention or even fitted linear heads can expose the boundary.

ideas.falsifier: If no trap separates pooling from anchors, design harder position/semantic interference.
ideas.minimum_test: Synthetic long-context retrieval with semantic clusters and position-only decoys; compare pooled latents, anchor tokens, and full attention.
ideas.name: Latent-Condensed Pooling vs Anchor Trap
ideas.question: Can semantic pooling preserve content while anchor selection preserves order, or do they fail on different decoy patterns?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Tensor-only first; tiny trained model later.

ideas.falsifier: If denoising hurts all retrieval cases, identify whether the synthetic cache lacks shared context.
ideas.minimum_test: Add spiked matrix generator to KV wind tunnel; quantize raw cache vs residual after low-rank shrinkage.
ideas.name: Spectral Denoise-Then-Quantize KV Probe
ideas.question: When is cache quantization better after removing a low-rank shared context component?
ideas.why_scale_fits: NumPy SVD at small sizes is cheap.

ideas.falsifier: If two-stage sharing gives no speed/quality benefit in a toy, keep as systems note.
ideas.minimum_test: Toy recommender sequence: retrieve candidates then rerank with cross-attention; reuse prefix cache and compare compute/accuracy.
ideas.name: Cross-Stage Cache Reuse Toy
ideas.question: Can one prefix cache feed both retrieval and reranking heads without doubling context computation?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Can be synthetic and small; useful systems-design lens.

ideas.falsifier: If covariance learning is no better than random Fourier features, postpone.
ideas.minimum_test: Rank sweep over random-feature covariance on XOR/parity/local-comparison tasks.
ideas.name: Learned Random Subspace Geometry
ideas.question: How much of a tiny network task is captured by learning covariance geometry for random features rather than exact weights?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small MLPs and covariance factors only.

ideas.falsifier: If greedy ablation always matches learned policy, no need for RL.
ideas.minimum_test: Train tiny models on induction/recall; let bandit/RL choose ablations to maximize target-specific damage minus general loss damage.
ideas.name: Circuit Discovery as Bandit/RL Toy
ideas.question: Can intervention-choice agents discover tiny transformer circuits with less bespoke analysis?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small action spaces; can begin with bandits before RL.

ideas.falsifier: If query-conditioned depth mixing cannot beat simple final-only or residual averaging in controlled midlayer/late-noise cases, archive until a trained model exists.
ideas.minimum_test: Run the depth-value mixing simulator on monotonic, midlayer-best, late-noise, and decoy-layer scenarios; compare final-only, uniform depth mean, recent-depth mean, and query-conditioned depth attention.
ideas.name: Depth-Axis Cache / Cross-Layer Value Mixing
ideas.question: Can a tiny model or tensor stack recover useful earlier-layer information when later layers over-write, decoy, or noise it?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Tensor-only depth stacks; no training needed for first falsifier.

ideas.falsifier: If fixed blocks match dynamic merging under adversarial transition placement, deprioritize dynamic linear-attention implementations.
ideas.minimum_test: Run non-stationary synthetic sequences with hidden transitions; compare fixed uniform blocks, recency-highres blocks, random adjacent merging, and drift-aware merging.
ideas.name: Dynamic State Merging for Bounded Linear Memory
ideas.question: Can content-aware state boundaries preserve transitions better than fixed block summaries at the same memory-state budget?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Pure NumPy; small state budgets and visible boundary-F1/MSE curves.

ideas.falsifier: If static value banks never beat context values on constructed identity-preservation cases, drop the lane.
ideas.minimum_test: Run `experiments/bank_of_values/bov_probe.py` across context drift/noise and context-signal strength; plot identity recall vs contextual-attribute recall.
ideas.name: Bank-of-Values Identity Preservation Probe
ideas.question: When do context-free token value banks beat residual-derived values, and when do they erase needed context?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Pure NumPy attention lookup; no training or corpus needed.

ideas.falsifier: If blurry memory only wins on smooth sinusoids and collapses on moderate spikes/anchors, keep only as a smooth-history submodule.
ideas.minimum_test: Run Fourier/blurry reconstruction and FadeMem hierarchy probes; measure old MSE, anchor retention, and spike recall.
ideas.name: Blurry / Frequency Window Memory
ideas.question: Can frequency/binned memory preserve old smooth structure better than literal sliding windows without hallucinating sharp needles?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Signal-level and interval-level probes are tiny and interpretable.

ideas.falsifier: If stabilization requires reading nearly all blocks except trivial cases, deprioritize ART-like logic.
ideas.minimum_test: Run `attention_runtime_termination/art_probe.py` on front-loaded, tail-surprise, diffuse, and late-direction-flip caches.
ideas.name: Attention Runtime Termination Trap Suite
ideas.question: Can output-stability early termination save attention reads without missing late direction flips?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Blockwise tensor attention is cheap and gives immediate read-fraction/error curves.

ideas.falsifier: If dashboard summaries hide too much nuance, use it only as an index and keep cell notes as source of truth.
ideas.minimum_test: Aggregate probe outputs into one dashboard with rows, metric summaries, categorical hints, and smoke status.
ideas.name: Cache Dashboard / Probe Scorecard
ideas.question: Can we compare all toy probes without re-reading every JSON/CSV by hand?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Pure tooling; makes the cube easier to reopen.

ideas.falsifier: If low-rank memory just memorizes keys without retrieval robustness, postpone.
ideas.minimum_test: Toy document QA: fit a low-rank document adapter or soft tokens, then sweep retained cache percentage and answer from cache+adapter.
ideas.name: Parameter Memory vs Context Cache Crossover
ideas.question: At what compression level does parametric or soft-token memory become more useful than explicit KV evidence?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Small synthetic docs/facts make adapter capacity measurable on CPU.

ideas.falsifier: If uniform budgets are near oracle across heterogeneous head roles, head-aware scheduling may be systems-only for us.
ideas.minimum_test: Construct heads with local/global/anchor/noise roles and compare uniform, role-aware, learned, and oracle budgets.
ideas.name: Head-Aware Budget Allocation
ideas.question: Are per-head cache budgets determined by role, query regime, or layer depth?
ideas.why_scale_fits: Synthetic multi-head attention can expose budget pathologies before systems work.

ideas.falsifier: If mixed precision reduces to simple value-norm top-k plus int8 everywhere else, keep simple.

ideas.question: Does spectral/low-rank regularization cause simpler circuits or just underfit tiny algorithmic tasks?
ideas.minimum_test: Modular arithmetic with spectral diagnostics and low-rank decay proxy.
ideas.falsifier: If rank collapse does not precede generalization or causes underfitting, demote.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Segment-Level KV Reuse Correction
ideas.question: Can sparse recomputation repair non-prefix reused segment state after interleaving changes context interactions?
ideas.minimum_test: Interleaved repeated-segment simulator with sparse boundary/key recompute.
ideas.falsifier: If sparse correction cannot beat raw segment reuse, inspect token-selection signal.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Head-Aware KV Object Model
ideas.question: Should probes stop treating cache as a monolithic token list and instead assign head-level roles/ranges?
ideas.minimum_test: Head-role simulator with head-specific budgets, temporal horizons, and critical-token ownership.
ideas.falsifier: If uniform budgets match head-aware budgets under role heterogeneity, demote.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Schema Patch as Research Infrastructure
ideas.question: Can the cube make old heterogeneous probes comparable without pretending there is one leaderboard?
ideas.minimum_test: Patch primary metrics and produce graph specs/family reports.
ideas.falsifier: If the schema layer hides caveats, split reports by family.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Compression-as-Supervision Taxonomy
ideas.question: Which methods use compression as answer storage, routing, query adaptation, parametric memory, or transition supervision?
ideas.minimum_test: Annotate new cells and priority list by role.
ideas.falsifier: If role tags do not change code priorities, remove them.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Adapter Conflict / Stale Parametric Memory
ideas.question: When does a strong adapter become harmful because the world has changed but the KV context contains newer evidence?
ideas.minimum_test: Parametric memory conflict regime with stale adapter confidence and fresh context evidence.
ideas.falsifier: If gating never matters, make adapter confidence adversarial.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Evidence-Target Quality Sensitivity
ideas.question: How noisy can retrieved evidence supervision be before query-side adaptation hurts more than it helps?
ideas.minimum_test: Sweep false-positive evidence targets in EASE toy.
ideas.falsifier: If noise tolerance is flat, the toy target is too easy.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Latent Compactor Hybridization Rule
ideas.question: Can we predict when to allocate budget to latent summaries versus exact top-k anchors?
ideas.minimum_test: Sweep isolated-needle frequency and cluster entropy in Still compactor toy.
ideas.falsifier: If one strategy dominates all regimes, reduce bias or retire hybrid rule.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: From Tensor Traps to Tiny Training Gate
ideas.question: Which tensor probes deserve escalation into trained tiny models?
ideas.minimum_test: Add an escalation score: surprise, falsifiability, training cost, interpretability.
ideas.falsifier: If the score always mirrors priority, simplify to priority labels.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Sparse Reuse vs Shared Routing
ideas.question: Are segment-reuse corrections and shared routing actually the same problem at different granularities?
ideas.minimum_test: Compare per-token shared routing to per-segment sparse recompute on same synthetic supports.
ideas.falsifier: If no shared failure modes emerge, keep them separate.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Parametric Memory as Decoding-Time Control
ideas.question: Is adapter memory best modeled as an encoder of documents or as a decoder-time answer prior that fills cache holes?
ideas.minimum_test: Separate encode-time and decode-time adapter contributions in the parametric-KV toy.
ideas.falsifier: If encode-time and decode-time effects cannot be separated, redesign.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as a small numpy probe or later tiny training task on CPU.

ideas.name: Entropy-Guided Head/Segment Budget Arena
ideas.question: Can attention entropy identify rigid vs dynamic heads online, and when is entropy insufficient without decode-conditioned future support?
ideas.minimum_test: Runnable synthetic head/segment probe comparing uniform, offline, entropy-adaptive, decode-conditioned, random, and oracle budget policies.
ideas.falsifier: If entropy-conditioned policies never beat uniform/offline budgets outside oracle settings, demote this lane.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Reasoning Branch Cache Sharing and Confident Exit
ideas.question: Can semantically similar reasoning branches safely share cache, and can entropy/confidence stop verification early without near-miss contamination?
ideas.minimum_test: Runnable branch-cluster simulation with exact prefix reuse, hidden-similarity reuse, conservative reuse, confidence exit, entropy exit, and oracle cluster sharing.
ideas.falsifier: If safe similarity sharing is dominated by exact prefix reuse in near-miss regimes, keep only as a systems negative result.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Agentic DFS Search Normal Form
ideas.question: Is tree search/backtracking the right tiny task for observing specialized action-trace and failure-trace mechanisms in a small transformer?
ideas.minimum_test: Stochastic k-ary tree environment with random, greedy, action-only, failure-only, DFS, ranked DFS, and oracle policies before training.
ideas.falsifier: If DFS does not separate from one-head ablations under depth generalization, the task is too weak or poorly instrumented.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Spatio-Temporal Cache Drift for GUI-like Trajectories
ideas.question: Do spatial subspace roles and temporal redundancy drift enough that one fused saliency map is structurally wrong?
ideas.minimum_test: Grid-token trajectory simulator with subspace-aware scoring and temporal stability discount.
ideas.falsifier: If fused top-k survives all role-migration traps, demote STaR-style scoring for text-only toys.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Exact Linear Attention Kernel Wind Tunnel
ideas.question: Which kernel constraints prevent token dilution and gradient/pathology in linear attention toy recall?
ideas.minimum_test: Compare exact-kernel variants, ordinary linear attention, softmax attention, and ridge associative memory on recall and stability.
ideas.falsifier: If kernel variants all behave like low-rank ridge memory on our tasks, keep this only as theory notes.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Context-Intensive Extraction Compression Stressor
ideas.question: Do compression methods pass needle lookup but fail when the output requires many independent facts from the prompt?
ideas.minimum_test: Tiny Text2JSON-like generator: streams of facts must be emitted as structured records after cache compression/offloading.
ideas.falsifier: If single-needle and many-fact extraction have identical rankings, the stressor is not adding value.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Looped Constant-Memory Reasoning Comparator
ideas.question: When does shared/gated loop memory approximate per-loop KV cache, and when does iterative state overwrite destroy search?
ideas.minimum_test: Compare per-loop cache, shared gated cache, attractor-style refinement, and linear/sparse loop variants on pointer chase/state tracking.
ideas.falsifier: If shared memory never beats a fixed sliding cache at same bytes, do not escalate looped models yet.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Whole-Document vs Per-Document Sharding Analogy
ideas.question: Can systems sharding ideas inspire better cache segmentation for repeated long documents and branch workloads?
ideas.minimum_test: Synthetic segment packing/object layout simulation: whole-doc blocks, per-doc blocks, and mixed shards under reuse and load balance.
ideas.falsifier: If segmentation has no effect on toy reuse/repair cost, leave FlashCP as systems-only reference.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Entropy-Stability Early Exit Calibration
ideas.question: Is stable entropy a better early-exit signal than raw confidence in multi-step verification?
ideas.minimum_test: Use RKSC probe rows plus adversarial high-confidence wrong cases; sweep entropy slope thresholds and calibration noise.
ideas.falsifier: If entropy stability fails on confidence traps too, early exit needs a stronger hidden-state agreement signal.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Less-Context Stale-Interference Agent Trap v2
ideas.question: Can retaining all history harm a toy agent compared with recent-tool pruning plus summaries?
ideas.minimum_test: Extend Less-context trap with stale facts, tool outputs, and subgoal summaries; compare full history, recency, summary, intent filtering.
ideas.falsifier: If full context never underperforms, the stale interference setup is too weak.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Sparse Segment Reuse Correction Battery
ideas.question: When repeated non-prefix segments can be reused, how much sparse correction is needed to restore cross-segment interactions?
ideas.minimum_test: Segment reuse simulator with exact prefix, segment cache, sparse-Q correction, and full recompute upper anchor.
ideas.falsifier: If sparse correction cannot beat no-reuse at safe error rates, demote segment-level cache sharing.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.

ideas.name: Cache Probe Taxonomy Refactor v2
ideas.question: Can the cube separate probes by role, failure mode, and metric family so priority decisions stop being manual?
ideas.minimum_test: Traceability report plus per-family metric status; classify every new probe as retention, routing, bounded memory, runtime, search, or training-signal.
ideas.falsifier: If reports still cannot surface orphaned P0 sources or stale probe outputs, strengthen schema rather than adding more experiments.
ideas.why_scale_fits: Runs as symbolic/tensor toy; no large model needed.
